items.资讯标题: AI 陪聊公司 Character 破产，用户私密聊天记录能拍卖吗？
items.desc: 虽然 Character 在原有的隐私协议中已经告知用户，出售公司资产时可能会披露包括用户聊天数据在内的某些信息，但这种告知方法并不符合《个人信息保护法》规定的收集个人信息应当限于实现处理目的的最小范围的原则，以及公司破产后，数据接收方变更原先的处理目的、处理方式的，应当重新取得个人同意的规定。但现在拍卖的买受方获取这些用户聊天数据的目的已经转为训练 AI，目的既然已经变更，就需要告知用户其收集这些数据的目的，并且再次取得用户的同意，才能够合法获取这些数据。最后，用户愿意把自己的秘密告诉 AI，是因为相信自己是在一个相对私密的环境中交流，AI 公司既然享受用户信任带来的商业利益，也应当承担相应的数据保护责任，即便企业破产也不能成为这些责任消失的理由。

items.资讯标题: StateBench: Testing how language models track state changes over long documents
items.desc: We're introducing StateBench, a benchmark for long-context state tracking—how well language models keep track of information about entities in long documents as they evolve. To this end, we developed the StateBench benchmark to capture state-tracking problems of different complexity, which we used to evaluate the differences between language models with different architectures. We find that recurrent and hybrid models can generalize much farther than transformers when trained directly on these tasks, while frontier models including Gemini 3.8 Flash, Claude Opus 5.5, and GPT-6 Sol and Luna still break down on harder forms of state tracking as inputs grow longer.

items.资讯标题: Qwen 3.8 27B on my laptop can interpret model weights, too
items.desc: The paper found that frontier models, in particular GPT-6 Astra, can both interpret and modify the raw weights of a machine learning model—literally a text description of the model containing a bunch of floating point numbers. I've been playing with one of the examples from the paper and I'm delighted to share that Qwen 3.8 27B running on my laptop can do this as well. Likewise, asked to make Qwen3.5-0.8B better at math without gradients, Astra identifies an issue in its weights causing reasoning loops that Qwen's own model card warns about, and fixes this by natively editing 0.016% of the weights.

items.资讯标题: AI Is Changing How Semiconductor Fabs Work — and Engineers Are Moving Faster Because of It
items.desc: For engineers, understanding how a process change will behave, how a material will interact with a new step, and how a defect maps back to a root cause are critical, challenging steps in semiconductor manufacturing — and these analyses can take days. Together, these capabilities describe an AI-defined fab: a semiconductor manufacturing factory where AI helps engineers optimize processes, catch problems earlier and make better decisions across the full chip manufacturing lifecycle. The future of semiconductor manufacturing lies in connecting these capabilities: using production data to inform models and models to evaluate changes, then bringing those findings back to the engineers making production decisions.
